changelog: Subtitle burn-in follows at most three validated redirects and never forwards Cookie or Authorization credentials to another origin
Subtitle burn-in rejects HTML and other unsupported subtitle response types, disables transparent compression and caps subtitle input at 2 MiB
Subtitle burn-in rejects connection-managed or oversized request headers before subtitle fetching or Media3 setup
message: CS3M v662 — hardened subtitle burn-in redirects and input boundaries
